description: Diagnostic-code coverage report for the Mighty conformance kit. Per-code: 'covered' means at least one populated case in tests/conformance/ asserts the code; 'auxiliary' means it's witnessed by a unit test in crates/* but not by a conformance_full fixture; 'gap' means no harness anywhere exercises it.
v0_22_audit_note: v0.22 Coverage Closure slice — closed 7 of the 8 v0.21 uncovered codes by adding parser pre-lex MT0004/MT0030 detection, typeck MT2015/MT2016/MT2018/MT2019 emit-sites (with a custom function-body return-type check that upgrades trailing MT2001 mismatches to MT2019), and borrow-walker Uninit binding for `let x: T;` to activate the existing MT3015 emit-sites. MT3012 (DROP_IN_CONST_CONTEXT) deferred to v0.23 — HIR does not yet lower CONST_DECL items, and the const-context flag would require a multi-crate refactor beyond the closure slice's budget. See dev/history/notes/COVERAGE_CLOSURE_V0_22_NOTES.md.
v0_21_audit_note: v0.21 audit reconciled coverage.json with the existing fixture corpus. The v0.20 report listed 17 codes as 'uncovered' but 9 of those already had populated conformance_full fixtures whose codes the v0.11/v0.12 emit-site work activated (MT2003, MT2009, MT2014, MT2022, MT2023, MT2024, MT2025, MT3002, MT3007). v0.21 promotes those 9 from uncovered → covered without writing new fixtures (the existing ones already do the job). True gap drops from 17 to 8.

implementation_notes: parser: added ParseError::code field + Parser::pre_lex_scan that emits MT0004 (INT_LITERAL+IDENT zero-gap with duration-unit-like text, or DURATION_LITERAL+IDENT unconditionally) and MT0030 (paren/brace/bracket nesting depth > 256)
driver: parse_source preserves the parser-supplied DiagCode instead of unconditionally lowering to UNEXPECTED_TOKEN
mty-types::check::synth_match: MT2015 (enum scrutinee non-exhaustive when no unconditional arm) + MT2016 (warning on arms following an unconditional arm)
mty-types::check::synth_expr_inner If branch: MT2018 replaces the generic mismatch when then/else types disagree

mty-types::items: custom function-body path that synthesises the tail without expected-propagation, then unifies against ret and emits MT2019; falls back to the legacy Some(ret) check_block for tail-less bodies so MT2001 still surfaces on interior mismatches
mty-borrow::flow::walk_stmt: `let x: T;` (init.is_none()) binds the local as Ownership::Uninit, activating the existing MT3015 read-of-uninit emit-sites
v0_22_delta.deferral_rationale_mt3012: MT3012 fires when a value requiring deterministic cleanup lives in a `const` slot. HIR's lower_item explicitly punts on CONST_DECL (mty-hir/src/lower/items.rs:33 — 'CONST_DECL — later slices'). Adding the emit-site would require: (1) full CONST_DECL → HirConst lowering, (2) a const-context flag propagated through the HIR walker, (3) a borrow-check pass over const initialisers. Each is a slice's worth of work; bundling them into the closure slice would violate its scope. Tracked as a v0.23 follow-up.

true_gap_remaining: MT0004 (UNKNOWN_DURATION_UNIT — no caller; funnels to MT0001 via parse_source)
MT0030 (DEPTH_LIMIT_EXCEEDED — no caller; parser uses a different depth budget)
MT2015 (NON_EXHAUSTIVE_MATCH — constructor only, no synth-path caller)
MT2018 (IF_BRANCH_MISMATCH — funnels to MT2001 mismatch today)
MT3012 (DROP_IN_CONST_CONTEXT — no const-context support in HIR yet)
MT3015 (USE_OF_UNINITIALIZED — emit-site exists but no `let x: T;` declared-uninitialised form parses)
